variables.label: watch-side wrist angular velocity
known_ambiguities: watch sensor frame is not automatically an anatomical forearm frame
non_claims: does not establish elbow or shoulder torque

variables.label: longboard angular velocity
known_ambiguities: video derivative quality depends on frame rate and marker visibility
non_claims: angular velocity alone does not establish absolute board orientation

variables.label: left plantar normal-load fraction
known_ambiguities: requires temporally overlapping left and right pressure measurements

variables.label: foot contact onset and release timing
known_ambiguities: visual and pressure definitions of contact may differ physically
non_claims: contact timing does not identify full contact force vector

variables.label: global body translation
known_ambiguities: single uncalibrated monocular video is insufficient for metric world translation
non_claims: not available as metric world translation when camera calibration is absent

variables.label: full-body joint torque
known_ambiguities: current sensor set lacks sufficient force and inverse-dynamics constraints
non_claims: MotionOS M1-A does not estimate validated joint torque

variables.label: full 3D ground-reaction force
known_ambiguities: plantar normal pressure does not measure the complete 3D force vector
non_claims: bilateral insoles are not treated as force plates

notes: Teacher eligibility means the variable may enter a future teacher target only after its reference quality is characterized.
Unidentifiable variables remain explicit so downstream models cannot quietly invent them.
